name: Jelly Cream Whisk
skillFull: Whisks Jellies on the map at certain intervals. Depending on the ratio of whisked Jellies, it will create either a Basic Cupcake Jelly, Yellow Cupcake Jelly, Pink Cupcake Jelly, or Frozen Cupcake Jelly. Level Up for more points per Cupcake Jelly.
